title: Eisaku Wada's Fuji Studies
content: While looking into Japan's tradition of European-influenced Yōga painting I ran across the work of Eisaku Wada (1874-1959).He did a lot of plein air studies of Mount Fuji, which were evidently painted on location.Eisaku Wada was chosen by the Ministry of Education to study in France.He also learned fromKuroda Seiki, who had studied in Paris.He returned to Japan and became a professor of Tokyo University of Arts.----Wikimedia Commons on Wada Eisaku
